paper_title: Feedback Friction LLMs Struggle to Fully Incorporate External Feedback
caption: Accuracy of Llama3.3 on PopQA with respect to s_pop and o_pop
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the accuracy of a model, denoted as Llama3.3, on the PopQA dataset, comparing initial and final accuracy values. The x-axis, labeled “(_pop_frequency) (x10^4)”, uses a linear scale ranging from 1 to 19, with tick intervals of 2 representing a frequency scale. The y-axis, labeled “Accuracy”, ranges from approximately 0.3 to 1.0, marked in increments of 0.1. A solid green line represents the initial accuracy, starting at approximately 0.42 and decreasing to 0.35 at x=1, with fluctuating values around 0.40 throughout the x-axis. A blue dashed line represents the final accuracy, starting at approximately 0.82 and decreasing to 0.76 at x=19, with fluctuating values around 0.80 throughout the x-axis. Error bars, depicted as green squares, are present alongside each point, consistent with the data values shown.
